correctness.rationale: For strictly positive rank-one B=uw^T with identical strain dynamics, common recovery d, and the physical Euler step restriction, w^Tx^(r) is multiplied at each generation by the common positive factor 1-hd+h sum_i w_i u_i(1-z_i), preserving each weighted share. Subtraction of q_r times total equation cancels infection exactly and yields x_i^(r)-q_r z_i=(1-hd)^k initial discrepancy. For rho=w^Tu<d, scalar S decays geometrically; at rho=d, transverse profile errors are O(S^2), z_i/S->u_i/d and reciprocal S increments ->h sum_i w_i u_i^2/d, yielding k x_i^r ->q_r u_i/(h sum_i w_i u_i^2). For rho>d, monotone sub/supersolution iteration traps every nonzero total state at unique endemic z*. The all-interior initial-condition quantifier in the converse forces w^TM(z) proportional to w^T for every z, and varying z_i proves each row B_i proportional to w. Independently verified exact rational 2-node, 3-strain share identity for 16 generations, not a universal-time proof.
residual_risks: Only deterministic additive-incidence Euler SIS with identical strains and common node-independent healing; homogeneous Euler step bound is essential to monotone state-space argument. Criticality is an infinite-time rate, not stochastic extinction.

value.rationale: The initial weighted shares explicitly select a point of a known neutral coexistence continuum, the exact all-time nodewise exchange mode decays at (1-hd)^k, and the converse characterizes precisely which positive contact matrices conserve such a share for all initial states. These are motivated invariants and a structural rigidity theorem, not another existence-only neutral equilibrium result.
residual_risks: Related continuous-time neutral systems have equilibrium planes; the useful new point is discrete selection, critical profile and rank-one iff, not existence of coexistence per se.
